applicant.name: Prof. Dr. Katrin Ebner
applicant.organisation: Medizinische Universität Graz, Institut für Kardiovaskuläre Versorgungsforschung

purpose: We are developing and externally validating a 30-day readmission risk score for patients with heart failure. The model works on each patient's timeline: the sequence and spacing of hospital stays, diuretic and other prescriptions around discharge and comorbidities. Readmission is defined per stay and per patient, so pre-aggregated tables cannot reproduce the outcome or the predictors; we need pseudonymised patient-level histories inside the secure environment and will export only coefficients and validation metrics.
question: Make pseudonymised conditions, medications and encounters available for adults with heart failure who had at least one inpatient stay in 2024 or 2025.
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Heart failure = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with I50.
Inpatient stay = encounter with type 'inpatient' whose start_date is between 1 January 2024 and 31 December 2025.
Cohort = adults with heart failure who have at least one such inpatient stay.
Report the number of patients in the cohort.
